description: This file defines the tlRestApi class which implements a RESTful API for managing test projects, test plans, test cases, builds, and other entities in the TestLink testing framework. It includes routes, authentication, and handlers for creating, updating, and retrieving various test management resources, utilizing the Slim framework.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: A class implementing REST API endpoints for managing test repositories, including projects, plans, test cases, builds, keywords, and test executions in the TestLink framework using the Slim PHP framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the REST API, sets up routes, database connections, managers, and configuration.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates requests based on API key provided in headers or auth credentials.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns information about the current authenticated user.

methods.name: superman
methods.description: Test route that identifies the API and class.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves either all accessible projects or specific project details.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Returns all test plans associated with a specified project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Fetches the latest version info of all test cases in a project, including keywords and custom fields.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project based on supplied JSON data.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan from provided data.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case with detailed steps, metadata, and associations.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build associated with a test plan, with options for copying testers and setting release information.

methods.name: getUserIDByAttr
methods.description: Retrieves user ID based on login or ID attributes.

methods.name: buildTestCaseObj
methods.description: Constructs a standardized test case object from input data.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Validates related entities such as test project and test suite existence and association.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific rights within a given context.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a new keyword associated with a test project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Retrieves builds associated with a test plan identified by API key.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing build.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Associates platforms to a test plan, validating their existence.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Outputs a 500 error response with a message.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Formats exception messages for debugging or logging.
